_source: Built from the facts of CBP ruling N356030 (3 Dec 2025): strut assembly put together in Thailand around a shock absorber assembled in Thailand from a Chinese tube, piston rod and oil; CBP held China. Later ruling N364865 (1 Oct 2026): shock absorber made in Thailand from raw steel (piston rod machined, reservoir tube welded, valves built, oil filled, nitrogen charged); CBP held Thailand. Post-cutoff pair BA-N356030-N364865 (D170).

product.name: Strut assembly
product.description: A passenger-vehicle strut assembly: a shock absorber inside a coil spring with a strut mount, spring seats, bumpers and a dust shield.

components.name: coil spring, bumper stop and strut dust shield
strut mount, upper spring bumper, upper spring seat, spring seat, bottom cover and lugs

operations.name: assemble the shock absorber components into a complete shock absorber
insert the shock absorber into the coil spring and fit the remaining components
